vocabulary.example: I went to Busan last year.
I traveled to Japan last month.
I moved here two years ago.
I didn't sleep well last night.
vocabulary.example_ko: 저는 어젯밤에 잠을 잘 못 잤어요.

grammar.explanation_en: Regular verbs add '-ed' in the past (visit → visited, play → played). Irregular verbs change form completely (go → went, eat → ate, see → saw) and must be memorized. Negatives use 'didn't + base verb', and questions use 'Did + subject + base verb?'.
grammar.explanation_ko: 규칙동사는 과거형에 '-ed'를 붙입니다(visit → visited, play → played). 불규칙동사는 형태가 완전히 바뀌며(go → went, eat → ate, see → saw) 외워야 합니다. 부정문은 'didn't + 동사원형', 의문문은 'Did + 주어 + 동사원형?'을 씁니다.

examples.en: I visited my grandmother last weekend.
She went to Jeju Island two years ago.
Did you see that movie? — No, I didn't.
examples.ko: 그 영화 봤어요? — 아니요, 안 봤어요.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.line: Did you do anything fun last weekend?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Yes! I went hiking with my friends. It was great.
dialogue.line_ko: 네! 친구들이랑 등산 갔어요. 정말 좋았어요.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.line: Of course. I took a lot of pictures of the mountain.

reading.title: My Trip to Jeju
reading.text: Last summer, I visited Jeju Island for the first time. I stayed there for five days. I saw beautiful beaches and ate delicious seafood. I also climbed a mountain, but I didn't reach the top because it was too windy. It was an unforgettable trip.
reading.text_ko: 지난여름 저는 처음으로 제주도를 방문했어요. 거기서 5일 동안 머물렀어요. 아름다운 해변을 봤고 맛있는 해산물을 먹었어요. 산도 올랐지만, 바람이 너무 심해서 정상까지는 못 갔어요. 정말 잊지 못할 여행이었어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'I stayed there for five days.'
The text says 'because it was too windy.'
